recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一團緊密黏聚（cohesive）的大型非造血細胞，細胞邊界不清呈融合狀、細胞質藍色，並有數個大空泡把細胞核推擠到一側（類似印戒細胞），與周圍散在的造血細胞明顯不同，提示轉移性腺癌（胃癌）。
features: Cohesive three-dimensional cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells with indistinct, syncytial cell borders
Large nuclei with fine-to-coarse chromatin, some with visible nucleoli, and nuclear size variation
Moderately abundant basophilic cytoplasm containing large clear mucin-like vacuoles that indent nuclei (signet-ring-like)
Cluster much larger than surrounding hematopoietic cells; neutrophil and small lymphocyte nearby for scale
Background of lysed/crenated red cells and proteinaceous material
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hemodilute background with scattered hematopoietic cells. There is a cohesive cluster of large atypical cells with syncytial borders, enlarged pleomorphic nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm containing large clear vacuoles, some indenting the nuclei in a signet-ring-like fashion. The cells are substantially larger than adjacent neutrophils and lymphocytes and do not resemble any normal marrow element. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma; correlation with the trephine biopsy and immunohistochemistry (cytokeratin, CDX2) supports a gastric primary.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts are round-to-oval cells with eccentric nuclei and a detached perinuclear clearing (hof) arranged in loose rows, not tightly cohesive syncytial clusters with mucin vacuoles.
Megakaryocytes are single giant cells with a lobulated nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm, not groups of discrete vacuolated nuclei.

ddx.dx: Clumped leukemic or lymphoma cells (e.g., ALCL, Burkitt)
ddx.vs: Hematolymphoid cells may aggregate but lack true cohesion, and are cytokeratin-negative with CD45 or lineage marker expression.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These form rosettes or clumps of smaller cells with scant cytoplasm and occur mainly in children, lacking signet-ring mucin vacuoles.
